messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: 6 services failed KMS decrypt at startup in us-east-1. Error pattern: HTTP 502/504 from KMS endpoints and SDK timeouts. Affected: api-gateway, router, model-loader, webhook-processor, billing-proxy, metrics-shipper. Root event time 2026-03-15T18:12:01Z. Paging aaron (oncall). Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/alerts/1775154321

aaron (oncall): oncall acked. bringing sara and kevin in. creating #inc-1775154321. quick triage: is this region-local? any cross-region fallbacks configured?

sara: joining. looks regional. All failures point to kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com with 502/504s and SDK-level RetryError. sample trace from webhook-processor:
```
2026-03-15T18:11:58Z webhook-processor ERROR Unable to decrypt data key: botocore.exceptions.EndpointConnectionError: Could not connect to the endpoint URL: "https://kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/"
```

kevin: also seeing signing errors causing external webhook auth failures -> ~30% of webhook deliveries returning 401 from downstreams.

support: customers reporting startup failures for self-hosted connectors and webhook misfires. open tickets: CS-4720, CS-4723. Notifying enterprise customers on watchlist now.

vault-bot: Vault: last successful unwraps at 2026-03-15T18:10:30Z. Fallback vault tokens available for a limited set of services (expires in 2h). Listing allowed services: model-loader, metrics-shipper.

aaron (oncall): possible mitigations we can do immediately:
- use Vault unwraps (if available) to supply DEKs in-memory for allowed services
- failover KMS calls to another region KMS (us-west-2) via cross-region CMK if key policy allows
- increase KMS client retries and backoff window
- temporarily allow unencrypted cached DEKs for short window for non-prod / low-risk tenants
Which is fastest to implement?

kevin: fastest is Vault unwrap for services already authorized (few services). Longer: cross-region KMS requires key policy checks and might still hit KMS endpoints in other region.

sara: I'll run a patch to router and api-gateway to read DEK from Vault (vault unwrap path) and skip KMS decrypt if vault token unwrap succeeds. This requires a small env toggle: USE_VAULT_FALLBACK=true. Can canary in 10m.

security: note: any fallback must be audited and short-lived. Need explicit audit events and rotation plan. Approve Vault unwrap for emergencies only.

aaron (oncall): ok prioritize Vault unwrap for model-loader, api-gateway, router. kevin please check vault token permission scope. sara take canary.

kevin: verified vault tokens scoped and rate limited. performing a dry-run on staging.

(8m later)

sara: deployed canary for api-gateway (1 pod) and model-loader (1 pod) with USE_VAULT_FALLBACK=true. Monitoring startup. Logs show successful unwrap and service became healthy.

sara: canary looks good. starting progressive rollout to remaining api-gateway replicas. will hold on webhook-processor until we confirm signing behavior.

support: updated status page: "We are investigating KMS API errors in us-east-1 causing authentication and startup failures. Temporary mitigations being deployed. Next update in 30 minutes." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1775154321

aws-tam: AWS update: "Investigating elevated error rates for KMS in us-east-1 due to infrastructure event. Working on mitigation. No ETA yet." Provided request-ids to collect: request id list requested.

kevin: starting rollout to router and billing-proxy with vault fallback. note billing-proxy must maintain long-lived encryption at rest for billing tokens; we'll ensure unwrap only populates in-memory keys.

(20m later)

support: several customers confirm services recovered after our restart with fallback enabled. CS tickets updated. Some self-hosted connectors still failing if they contact us-east-1 directly; advising restart with env flag.

aaron (oncall): ask: do we expose a toggle for customers to opt into fallback? for now support will instruct restarts. We'll follow-up with more robust orchestrated recovery.

kevin: AWS responded with partial mitigation timeline: error rates improving; recommended to drain and restart KMS clients after 30m of stable responses. They gave a case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#CaseId=0-67890

sara: starting a measured revert plan: once KMS Decrypt success rate >99% for 10m we'll revert USE_VAULT_FALLBACK via rolling restart. Until then keep fallback on for critical services.

security: require rotated DEKs used for fallback and record justification. Also require a post-incident audit of any plaintext windows.

(36m later)

aws-tam: Update: KMS us-east-1 returning to normal; retries and 5xx have dropped. Continuing monitoring.

aaron (oncall): metrics show KMS decrypt success stable. running revert for api-gateway and model-loader now. revert plan: rolling restarts without fallback env var.

(After revert)

kevin: reverted fallback. No immediate regressions in the next 10m. Monitoring for any delayed startup failures.

support: updating customers: issue resolved; recommended restart if still impacted. Closing duplicate tickets.

aaron (oncall): incident moving to monitoring. I'll hand off to kevin for 6h watch. creating follow-ups:
- postmortem doc with timeline & decision log (owner: aaron)
- add automated multi-region KMS failover playbook (owner: sara)
- add Vault-unwrap emergency flow to runbook + audit events (owner: kevin)
- update alert thresholds to include high startup decrypt failure rates (owner: eng-ops)
- security: rotate fallback DEKs and review key policies (owner: security)

kevin: ack. I'll own watch and coordinate postmortem artifacts.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-20260315-9 created. Severity P1. Status -> Monitoring. Duration so far ~10m.

aaron (oncall): thanks team. closing active thread for response; continuing follow-ups in #postmortems.
